$comment: Hand-written files allowed under packages/*/src (docs/sdk-standard.md section 6). Everything else there must be generated (_generated/, gitignored). scripts/check-handwritten.mjs enforces this in CI. Entries with `until` go away in that task.

allow.why: The shared runtime: retries, errors, pagination, polling, webhooks verify.
Per-package entry point: re-exports the generated client plus hand-written extras.
One-line re-export of the generated mocks for the /testing subpath.
verifyToken: JWKS cache, issuer/audience pinning, refresh-token refusal, JWT errors.
Browser WebAuthn ceremonies, not HTTP calls.
The consumer scope's non-HTTP extras over the generated AuthConsumer: verifyToken, the JWKS cache, issuer/audience, passkey ceremonies.
Base of the generated Auth class: consumer(slug) with its own credential rule and top-level verifyToken.
Passport adapter; not an API surface.
Flags local evaluation: the pure engine (parse, evaluate, SHA-1/SHA-256) runs in the customer's process, not over HTTP (sdk-standard section 6).

Flags local evaluation: FlagsClient's delivery fetch loop, cache, overrides and hooks run in the customer's process, not over HTTP (task 015); platform.browser.ts is the browser / React Native build's swap for platform.ts (task 019).
OpenFeature provider over FlagsClient; not an API surface (task 016).
React bindings over FlagsClient (provider, hooks, SSR bootstrap); not an API surface (task 019).

Notify browser core: the real-time stream reader, client state (inbox store, token refresh, optimistic marks), the web push helper and the service worker are not HTTP operations; the calls go through the generated client scope of @productcraft/notify (sdk-standard section 6, task 018).

React components and hooks over the Notify browser core (provider, useInbox, usePreferences, NotifyInbox, NotifyPreferences, strings, the Markdown subset renderer); not an API surface, all state stays in @productcraft/notify-js (sdk-standard section 6, task 020).
